observations.content: Assistant is resolving merge conflicts in /projects/Recompia-Releases merging upstream commit 714c28c307a762382c4808ebc45ecaf4c1b220cf into the fork (merge-base 3731dda624730715a31d0987b524740a3ad81721); conflicted files are game-build/scripts/make-release.ps1 and .github/workflows/release.yml (both LF line endings).

Fork difference vs upstream: fork's make-release.ps1 takes third-party payload from -Tools (staged by fetch-windows-tools.ps1, nothing from earlier release) and bundles astcdec DLLs, DejaVuSans font and kbm_icons itself; upstream uses -Base previous release zip (BASE_REPO/BASE_RELEASE).

Upstream's rename change: two zips of same tree per release (release_names.rs): Recompia-<v>-windows-x64.zip with Recompia.exe plus stub starter as PokopiaLauncher.exe, and old-name PokopiaRecomp-<v>-win64.zip with full launcher as PokopiaLauncher.exe, no starter, shipped for three releases after rename; new -Stub param (recompia-stub.exe from launcher/stub). Old launchers (e.g. v0.15.3) match by old asset name.

completed: resolved make-release.ps1 conflict keeping fork's -Tools model plus upstream's two-zip description and -Stub/-Launcher recompia.exe params; removed 'over the base zip's old launcher' comments. Verified via diff against /tmp/mr_up.ps1 and /tmp/mr_ours.ps1.

release.yml has three conflict hunks at lines 5-13 (header comment), 457-483 (windows-package make-release call/check step, upstream uses gh release download BASE and -Base), and 1423-1430 (publish job comment; HEAD version mentions provenance attestation and draft release publishing). Upstream also renamed artifacts to Recompia-* (windows-x64, linux-x86_64, linux-aarch64, macos-aarch64, sources) and publish pattern to Recompia-*; win-launcher artifact now work/win-launcher with recompia.exe and recompia-stub.exe. Remaining: resolve these hunks without reintroducing BASE_REPO.
